adapter_evolution_dependency.rule: If a future EDCR adapter revision carries action-eligible artifacts, operational causes claims, protected/redacted provenance, embedded GSL declarations or another owner-qualified type, that revision must explicitly version its schema/profile and preserve the originating type, provenance and owner identity through normalization.
adapter_evolution_dependency.required_existing_owner_checks: Before downstream use, the applicable existing Compile, authority-provenance/intersection, causal-level, provenance-manifest, catalogue and assurance owners must validate the typed extension. Unrecognized or unresolved extensions fail closed.
adapter_evolution_dependency.no_new_authority_source: Adapter parsing, normalization, routing, compression or model output cannot create authority, increase causal strength, create protected status or admit semantics. The adapter transports owner-qualified data; it does not become the owner.
adapter_evolution_dependency.runtime_transition: Add executable owner invocation only when the corresponding typed field/class is actually introduced into the adapter; until then no dormant parallel authority/causal mechanism is implied.
